summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Smart Golf GPS & AI Caddie. 13/13 pytest backend tests pass covering courses CRUD, seeded demo course, bag, settings, rounds lifecycle, shots (Haversine verified: 0.01deg lat -> 1111.9m), club-stats, stats, elevation, and AI Caddie SSE streaming (tokens + [DONE] via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY / gpt-5.4-mini). Frontend flows validated on mobile viewport 390x844 with mocked geolocation (7.0545, 125.5195): Home menu + onboarding, Rangefinder (GPS badge 'GPS ±5m GOOD', target distance value, plays-like, bottom sheet, wind +20 headwind increased plays-like 77->87, hole nav, track shot -> club pick -> end shot -> save shot dialog), Start Round -> /play -> Scorecard steppers (score=4, putts=2) -> End Round -> RoundDetail, My Bag (32 club inputs = 16 clubs x carry/total), Caddie page renders structured distances + ASK AI CADDIE button, Settings units toggle + tournament toggle persists to backend, Course Editor loads with satellite map + mode buttons. Settings restored to distanceUnit=yd, tournamentMode=false. Demo course preserved.

issues: React dev instrumentation emits a hydration warning about <span> inside <option> in the hole <select>. This is coming from the dev instrumentation attributes (x-file-name/x-source-*), not app code; not visible in production. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: Rangefinder.js is ~408 lines and getting dense (map, sheet, wind, shot flow, club picker, shot dialog). Consider extracting BottomSheet, ShotResultDialog, ClubPicker into components for maintainability.

SettingsContext PUTs to /api/settings inside setSettings updater which is technically an impure side-effect inside a functional updater; works but recommended to fire the PUT in a useEffect on settings change to avoid duplicate PUTs under React StrictMode.
DELETE /api/shots wipes ALL shots with no scoping/confirmation server-side; UI has a confirm() but consider server-side safeguard or per-round scoping.

Rangefinder useEffect that resets target on holeIdx change also depends on `course` in its comment but disables the exhaustive-deps lint (line 66) - fine but note that changing course wouldn't retarget until holeIdx changes.
Caddie SSE endpoint has no request validation (accepts arbitrary dict). Consider Pydantic model to enforce required fields.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test round + TEST_ course/shots were created and cleaned up in pytest. Demo course 'demo-apo-davao' preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and pass 13/13 in ~6s. For frontend Playwright tests, ALWAYS use context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) + set_geolocation before navigating, viewport 390x844. IMPORTANT: use normal .click() (not force=True) on More page toggles like setting-tournament-mode - the button sits below the fold and force=True can miss the actual pixel; either scroll into view first or drop force=True. distanceUnit and tournamentMode were restored to yd/false at end of test. The dev-instrumentation warning about <span> in <option> can be ignored - it is from the DOM instrumentation adding x-* attributes, not the Scorecard code itself.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs. Initial appearance of a 'tournament toggle not persisting' bug was a test artifact caused by page.click(force=True) on a button that was below the viewport fold; a normal click confirmed correct end-to-end behavior (frontend -> PUT /api/settings -> DB -> reload -> rangefinder reads tournamentMode=true and hides plays-like + shows tournament-badge).
